predicted_relation: For a joint whose tangent-space motion subspace S(q) varies with its own configuration, analytical derivatives of generalized gravity, static torque, and RNEA with respect to that joint's tangent coordinates must include the joint-local configuration derivative of S (or the mathematically equivalent transport term). Cross-joint derivative blocks should remain unaffected by this local term.
predicted_mechanism: The affected derivative path treats the joint motion subspace / joint-local tangent mapping as configuration-independent when forming the same-joint dq block, omitting a dS/dq-equivalent contribution for Universal, SphericalZYX, and Ellipsoid joints. Recursive propagation between distinct joints is otherwise correct, explaining why off-diagonal blocks agree with finite differences while the three self blocks fail.
owner_boundary: The joint-local configuration derivative interface used by RNEA/generalized-gravity/static-torque derivative assembly for configuration-dependent motion-subspace joints, before the common recursive cross-joint propagation.
discriminating_experiment: For each affected and unaffected joint, finite-difference the joint-local motion subspace/tangent action with respect to its own tangent coordinates at the same q. Then isolate the analytical self-block residual (analytic minus central-difference dynamics derivative) and compare it to the contraction generated by the measured joint-local dS/dq term while keeping parent/child states fixed. The prediction is supported if affected joints have nonzero local dS/dq and the missing local contribution explains the self-block residual across gravity, static-torque, and zero-velocity/acceleration RNEA, while joints with q-independent motion subspaces remain near numerical noise.
falsifier: The prediction is falsified if the affected joints have zero joint-local motion-subspace/tangent derivative in the library's actual tangent convention, if the analytical self-block residual is not explained by the corresponding local derivative term, or if correcting that local contribution leaves the same O(1) diagonal-block error while another joint-local quantity or tangent-coordinate convention accounts for it.
repair_boundary: Repair the shared joint-local analytical derivative contract so configuration-dependent joints expose and consume the required motion-subspace/tangent derivative term in the self dq block. Do not special-case the three joint names, replace production analytical derivatives with finite differences, or alter cross-joint recursion that already matches the reference.
